name: seed + speed Ventures
identity_check: Confirmed as seed + speed Ventures (seedandspeed.com, LinkedIn /company/seedandspeed), the pre-seed and seed VC for B2B software startups founded and run by Carsten Maschmeyer and Alexander Kölpin, with its office at Poststr. 21-22, 10178 Berlin. The site imprint names Seed + Growth Capital Management GmbH, Maximilianstr. 34, Munich (HRB 313356, AG München), with managing directors Maschmeyer, Kölpin and Dr. Andreas Schenk. The Fund III key information document names seed + speed Ventures GmbH, Berlin, as the BaFin-registered AIFM of seed + speed III Fonds GmbH & Co. KG. Press also writes it as 'seed+speed Ventures'. Not Speedinvest and not other seed funds with 'speed' in the name.

thesis_text.value: Berlin early-stage VC backing pre-seed and seed B2B software and software-driven hardware startups, mainly in DACH; its €90M Fund III opens to the rest of Europe. Current focus is enterprise AI: startups building AI as core technology or tools to run it securely in business. Adds hands-on sales and marketing support; initial tickets about €0.5-2M, up to €5M in total.

open_items: Funds I and II: no size, vintage or close date found. They are only mentioned as 'Fonds I und II', focused on the German-speaking region (Startbase), and 'our first two seed+speed funds' (Tech.eu). The SaaS News says the firm was 'Founded in 2016', but that is a single source and was not confirmed.

Fund III (seed + speed III Fonds GmbH & Co. KG): the close date is the announcement date (28 Jan 2026), not a legal final-close date. The target was €30M and the hard cap was raised twice. Fundraising began in summer 2024, and 13 investments had been made by Jan 2026, with 7-9 new startups planned per year. The KID gives a €200,000 minimum LP commitment and a term of at least ten years.
The user-list leads 'B2B; Enterprise AI' and '2026 fund EUR 90M' are confirmed by the Fund III coverage and the firm's site.
Portfolio count: the homepage says 'over 50 companies' (recorded as 50, a lower bound). The portfolio page shows 48 company tiles, two marked as exits. Tech.eu Funding Explorer counts 29 rounds.

Nothing was found on investing in Indian founders, so that fact is omitted. No rule requiring a US entity was found, so it is recorded as unknown. The stated geography is Germany, Switzerland, Austria and Europe (DACH, Nordics, Benelux), and Fund III is the first open beyond DACH.

Partners: the team page lists no individual focus areas or LinkedIn profiles. Focus sectors for Kölpin and Maschmeyer are inferred from the deals they are quoted on and from the Fund III announcement. Press calls both 'Managing Partner', while the team page says 'Founder and Managing Director'. Senior Investment Managers Daniel Steffen and Isabelle Thierfelder, and Investment Managers Andreas de Greiff, Isabell Gollmer and Stefanie Mercedes Kindt (on parental leave), are not recorded because no stated focus was found. Dr. Andreas Schenk is a managing director per the imprint but is not on the team page.

Rounds not recorded: Kertos Series A (Sep 2025), Finperks pre-seed (2026; a search snippet cites CB Insights at $3.84M, not verified), briink (Sep 2024), mogenius (Jul 2024), Zortify (2024), and follow-ons in Meisterwerk, Enginsight and Prewave (2024). No round article was fetched for these. The firm's news page links to LinkedIn posts, which were not opened, per protocol.
UMH: the seed + speed portfolio page lists it as '2025 Seed', but Tech.eu reports the €5M round on 8 Jan 2026 without naming a stage. Its HQ country comes from the Tech.eu Funding Explorer (Cologne).
CERPRO amount: Startbase gives 'knapp zwei Millionen Euro' (just under €2M) and Tech Funding News 'approximately €2 million', so 2,000,000 is recorded as an approximation.
Company websites are not recorded because none was on the fetched pages. Founding year is missing for RIIICO, Eleven Dynamics and UMH.
